messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Take lisinopril exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Follow all directions on your prescription label and read all medication guides or instruction sheets. Your doctor may occasionally change your dose..
You may take lisinopril with or without food.
Measure liquid medicine with the supplied measuring device (not a kitchen spoon).
Your blood pressure will need to be checked often and you may need frequent blood tests.
Tell your doctor if you have a planned surgery.
Call your doctor if you have ongoing vomiting or diarrhea, or if you are sweating more than usual. You can easily become dehydrated while taking lisinopril. This can lead to very low blood pressure, an electrolyte imbalance, or kidney failure.
If you have high blood pressure, keep using lisinopril even if you feel well. High blood pressure often has no symptoms.
Store tightly closed at room temperature, away from moisture and heat. Do not freeze.
Triplet: ["Lisinopril", "has risk of", "very low blood pressure"]

The relation 'has risk of' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug may lead to or cause the adverse condition or complication specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
B. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
C. 'interacts with': The subject drug has a drug interaction with the drug or substance specified by the object entity that may change effects or cause harm.
D. 'has warning': The subject drug carries a safety warning or precaution about the risk or situation specified by the object entity.
E. 'use with caution in': The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
